title: Research talks in Shanghai
text: I gave talks at Shanghai Innovation Institute and East China Normal University, hosted by Professors Yuan Xie and Zhizhong Zhang.

title: Memento-Skills: Let Agents Design Agents
text: Our new preprint introduces agents that build and refine reusable skills, learning from experience without updating the underlying LLM.

title: Memento: Learning through memory
text: Our new preprint explores how LLM agents can adapt through memory-based reinforcement learning while keeping the underlying model fixed.
